name: hooknostic
description: Hooknostic CLI: check, build, doctor, inspect

scripts.bundle: node --input-type=commonjs -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --external:esbuild --outfile=dist/index.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --external:esbuild --outfile=dist/hooknostic.mjs --log-level=warning
